2. It is the case of the petitioners that they are businessmen and having good reputation in the society.
In view of the rivalry in the business, complaints were lodged against the petitioners by the rival group before respondent No.5.

The respondents- Police acting on the complaints of the rival group, registered cases in Crime Nos. 14 of 2023 and 15 of 2023 for the offences ::2::
under Sections 420 and 409 of IPC.
It is the further case of the petitioners that the police have registered false cases against them and also involved their family members and harassing them on one pretext or other.
The respondents-Police are calling the petitioners and their family members frequently to the police station.
3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appeearing for respondent Nos. 1 to 5 submits that the petitioners are involved in Crime Nos. 14 of 2023 and 15 of 2023.

For the purpose of investigation, the police have made enquiries with the petitioners and have not called the petitioners and their family members to the police station nor harassed them in any manner except investigating into the crimes.

4. In view of the said submissions, this Court deem it appropriate to direct respondent Nos. 4 and 5 not to harass the petitioners and their family members and not to interfere with their personal liberty in any manner except conducting investigation into the crimes in accordance with law.
